issues.reason: The instruction set reserves the bare class symbol for non-specific/generic objects and requires a definite description ('the milk') to mint 'a typed individual sk_<class>_<n> + its (Member …)' — even a first-mention or unique definite gets a fresh typed symbol.

The named roles apply only when the PP answers where the event happens, and the selling does not occur inside the bottles — the instruction set's own parallel: "'On the mural' is not a Location (they are not standing on it)".

gaps_confirmed: container/packaging PPs ('sold in glass bottles', 'packed in crates') — no stated routing of the container relation between the event and the goods
new_gaps: bare plural count noun as an oblique object ('in glass bottles') — the oblique object-NP rule covers only articles and bare mass/domain/proper names
repair_summary: Filled Theme with the typed witness sk_milk_1 and added its (Member sk_milk_1 milk); re-routed the packaging PP from (Location …) to the surface-preposition oblique (In sk_sell_1 glass_bottle).
notes: The In-oblique keeps the preposition actually used and asserts only the stated in-relation (the preposition-named-oblique fallback for a PP no named role fits), so nothing false remains; the glass_bottle constant and its bottle genus are untouched.
